labor.task: Fence: layout & staking 2,100 LF w/ Owner's Rep
Fence: hang, stretch & tie fabric 2,100 LF
Fence: hang 4 pedestrian gates + 1 double gate
Vehicular gate: footings, set post, receptacles, hang

scope.title: OLA chain-link fence and gates (Schedule A, 1/LS12)
scope.text: Furnish and install 2,100 LF of 4'-0" high off-leash-area chain-link fence, all components black vinyl coated: 1-7/8" line posts at 8'-0" o.c. in 8" dia footings, 2-3/8" corner/terminal posts, 2-7/8" gate posts in 12" dia footings, 1-5/8" top, mid and bottom rails, 2" mesh 9 ga fabric on inside of OLA, tension bars and bands at 12" o.c., ties at 12" o.c.; 4 pedestrian gates 3'-0" with kick plate and forked latch, and 1 maintenance double gate 12'-0" with drop rod. Alignment per Owner's Rep field direction to avoid existing trees.

scope.title: Vehicular access gate (Schedule A, 1/LS13, Spec 2.19)
scope.text: Fabricate and install 1 hinge-less vehicular swing gate (270° operation) with galvanized gate post (ASTM F1043 Group IA), greased sleeve, latches, 2 gate receptacle posts and roadway markers; white polyester texture powder coat.

scope.title: Removable bollards (Schedule A)
scope.text: Furnish and install 9 TrafficGuard RP3503 removable bollards (3.5" OD x 36", black, reflective label) and 6 additional in-ground bollard receivers, set in concrete footings.

scope.title: Bike racks and trash/recycle receptacles (Schedule A)
scope.text: Furnish and install 4 Landscape Forms 'Emerson' bike racks (surface mount, metallic silver) and 9 Plaza Series flared receptacles (5 trash / 4 recycle, teal, surface mount) with stainless anchors.

scope.title: Park signage structures (Schedules A & B base bid, Appendix D)
scope.text: Furnish and install 18 base-bid signs per Pierce County Parks Sign Standards: vehicular park entry (1), park info & rules (2), playground rules (1), playground welcome (1), trail directional (3), trail entry-large (3), low-profile (1), general pedestrian (2), shelter rules panels (2, column mount) and off-leash rules panels (2, fence mount), incl. steel frames/posts and footings. Sign panels/graphics carried as an allowance pending Appendix D review.

scope.title: Submittals and compliance
scope.text: Shop drawings, product data, color samples, L&I Intents/Affidavits and certified payroll.

exclusions: Picnic shelters (Romtec, Substitutive Alt. 1), picnic tables A/B, benches, dog mitt stations, car and trail counters, boardwalk, Knox box.
Split rail fence (494 LF base and 335 LF Alt. 4, cedar), Add Alt. 5 and Add Alt. 6 supply-only signs, playground equipment and surfacing.
Earthwork, paving, curbs, thickened concrete areas, rockeries, boulders; disposal of auger spoils off site (spread on site by others).
Performance & payment bond (add 1.5% if required), Washington retail sales tax (collected by prime per WAC 458-20-171), permits.
Gate count (4 pedestrian + 1 double maintenance) and terminal posts (16) are assumed — confirm on LS03/LS10 before award.
